<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ride On](/Feats.aspx?ID=5334) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Trigger**
You would gain the fatigued condition.

</column>

---

Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance. You delay the effects of the [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=73) condition for 3 rounds. If the fatigued condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the fatigued condition after this ability ends.
name: Ride On
